name: Please Be Funny
source:
For many, the circus is an escape. But for Clara, the circus is her life... and she's the punchline.

[From [url=https://sapphicore.itch.io/please-be-funny]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对许多人而言，马戏团是一处逃避现实的避风港。可对克拉拉来说，马戏团就是她的全部人生……而她自己，正是全场最大的笑柄。

[摘自[url=https://sapphicore.itch.io/please-be-funny]itch.io[/url]]
